def cdq(points={{points}}):
    points.sort(key=lambda p: (p[0], p[1], p[2]))
    n = len(points); ans = [0]*n
    def solve(l, r):
        if r - l <= 1: return
        m = (l+r)//2
        solve(l, m); solve(m, r)
        left = sorted(points[l:m], key=lambda p: p[1])
        right = sorted(points[m:r], key=lambda p: p[1])
        bit = [0]*(max(p[2] for p in points)+2)
        def upd(i, v):
            while i < len(bit): bit[i] += v; i += i & -i
        def qry(i):
            s = 0
            while i > 0: s += bit[i]; i -= i & -i
            return s
        i = 0
        for rp in right:
            while i < len(left) and left[i][1] <= rp[1]:
                upd(left[i][2]+1, 1); i += 1
            ans[points.index(rp)] += qry(rp[2]+1)
        for j in range(i): upd(left[j][2]+1, -1)
    solve(0, n)
    return ans
